template_data.sub: An expired SAM.gov registration freezes your GSA payment stream — even if your Schedule is fully active.
template_data.image_prompt: Infographic alert layout. Bold warning headline top: 'SAM LAPSES. PAYMENTS FREEZE.' with caution icon. Left side: illustrated professional in business blazer looking at laptop with alarmed expression, red notification badge overlay. Right side: three consequence rows with red warning icons — label 'NO ORDERS', label 'PAYMENTS STALL', label 'CONTRACT REVIEW'. Bottom: dark navy banner with short callout 'RENEW 90 DAYS EARLY'. Footer text: 'Josh Ladick · GSA Focus'.
